item.title: IID Offers Free Energy-Saving Upgrades to Help Customers Lower Utility Costs
item.description: Imperial Irrigation District customers have an opportunity to lower their energy bills and improve home comfort through the District’s All-Weather Energy Savings Program. item.title: Coachella Valley Commemorates International Holocaust Remembrance Day in Palm Desert
item.description: Community members from across the Coachella Valley gathered in Palm Desert to observe International Holocaust Remembrance Day, honoring the six million Jewish victims murdered by the Nazi regime during World War II at the 17th annual Holocaust Memorial at Civic Center Park.International Holocaust Remembrance Day is observed each year on January 27, marking the anniversary of the liberation of Auschwitz-Birkenau, the largest Nazi concentration and extermination camp in Poland. item.title: Coachella City Council Selects New Mayor Pro Tem After Months of Delay
item.description: A new mayor pro tem was officially selected during tonight’s Coachella City Council meeting, marking a significant moment for the city’s leadership. Councilmember Dr. Frank Figueroa was unanimously chosen to serve in the role, becoming the first openly gay official to hold the position in Coachella.Dr. Figueroa previously ran against current Mayor Stephen Hernandez in the November 2024 mayoral election. item.title: Fire Damages Palm Desert Home During Remodeling, No Injuries Reported
item.description: Riverside County Fire crews responded to a residential fire in Palm Desert tonight near the intersection of DeAnza Way and Monterey Avenue. Officials confirmed the fire was located in the attic of a home currently undergoing remodeling.The blaze caused approximately $75,000 in damage, but residents were able to safely evacuate before firefighters arrived. No injuries were reported, and emergency personnel quickly contained the fire.Fire officials noted that incidents like this are fairly common
